brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu described Britain as "the Islamic Republic of Britain" in remarks reflecting escalating friction between Israel and the UK's Labour government, Al Jazeera English reported. The comment came amid signs of growing tension between the two countries over policy differences.

The statement marks a sharp deterioration in diplomatic relations under Prime Minister Keir Starmer's administration. Britain has taken positions on Gaza and military support to Israel that have drawn Netanyahu's ire. The two nations have historically maintained close security and intelligence ties, though those bonds have become strained in recent months as the Labour government has pursued a distinct approach to Middle East policy.
dek: The Israeli PM's remark comes amid signs of growing tension between Israel and the UK's Labour government.
title: Netanyahu attacks UK as "Islamic Republic of Britain
